CB-LEDGER.interpretation: Finite circular ledger of actual first-send data segment lengths and seq32 exclusive ends. At most16 records, SMSS4. Retransmissions, SYN and FIN do not add a record. Existing protocol queues, sequence arithmetic and timers remain authoritative.

CB-CREDIT.interpretation: Pinned lwIP2.2.1 tcp_free_acked_segments releases complete original segments; recv_acked is reported through the public sent callback once per input in this <=16-byte scope. This optional service projection retires every whole segment covered by accepted cumulative ACK, not each newly ACKed byte. It is implementation-policy modeling, not a normative TCP callback requirement.

CB-ACK.interpretation: August2022 sections3.4/3.10.7.4: cumulative sequence-space acknowledgments are inherited unchanged. TCP byte credit and implementation callback credit are different observables. Accepted data ACK credit gates retirement; future/old/duplicate ACKs cannot fabricate callbacks.

CB-SCOPE.interpretation: cb_step_bytes is an explicit IR service observation, not a Python protocol callback. Metadata tracks at most one new-data emission per atomic rule and fails an invariant on overflow. Fixed source/witness replays and real public C callbacks do not prove general TCP, socket semantics, Nagle/SWS or translator/implementation refinement.
